title: A Deadly Parasite Hijacks Their Memories Part 2

series.summary: Rick seals the house to contain the parasite outbreak, but a shared elevator memory conjures Cousin Nicky into reality. When Nicky attempts to open the locked doors, Rick shoots him dead, revealing a transformed parasite and sparking family-wide paranoia that their memories are fabricated.

cuts.voiceover_text: Rick slams the house into lockdown to trap an alien parasite, sealing every window behind blast shields. He is convinced the family is safe inside, but the monster is already in the room.
Moments later, a fond elevator memory conjures Cousin Nicky straight into reality. The family embraces him, but Nicky urgently pushes everyone toward the locked exits.

Rick draws his blaster and shoots him dead. On the floor, Nicky morphs into a grotesque alien parasite. Rick counts heads: somebody here is an imposter. If every loving memory is a lie, who is actually real?
